confirmatory_protocol: Run ALL frozen capabilities (1-4) on these 44 sites exactly ONCE, scoring exact-site recognition + evidence + route against the external is_vulnerable/statement labels. No capability may be designed or tuned using any result from this corpus.
family_definition: Frozen by RULE, applied ONCE at the confirmatory measurement (not computed now, to avoid inspecting yields): cluster included sites by the destination-write PROOF OBLIGATION / representation shape (the same obligation-level unit used for Juliet and Magma), reported separately from external CWE category. Coarse external family = CWE write-category (787 OOB-write / 122 heap-overflow / 120 buffer-copy-overflow).
held_out_rule: Capability yields are NOT inspected on this corpus. Capabilities 2-4 are developed using ONLY Magma + synthetic controls. All frozen capabilities are run on this corpus ONCE as the confirmatory measurement.
inclusion_rule: external labels + destination-capacity WRITE property ONLY (NOT any TChecker outcome): CWE in {787 OOB-write, 122 heap-overflow, 120 buffer-copy-overflow}; exclude CWE-119 (read-or-write ambiguous); remove Magma-overlap projects (php-src/openssl/libsndfile/... ); dedup by (project,commit,filepath,func_name).
